title: Restricted Standard-WOFOST Two-Phase Crop-Window Composition

qualified_contract.inactive_crop: qualified exact no-op and skips all active-only dependencies
qualified_contract.daily_cadence: one successful complete invokes exactly one structural cohort shift/create
